```sql
-- SQLite schema for the notes service.
-- Every statement is idempotent so it can run on each start-up.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title      TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
    body       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
    id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_tags (
    note_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tag_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_note_tags_tag_id ON note_tags (tag_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_notes_created_at ON notes (created_at);
```

```python
"""Notes service: FastAPI + sqlite3."""

import os
import re
import sqlite3
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterator, List, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

SCHEMA_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("schema.sql")
TAG_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]{1,30}")
TITLE_MIN = 1
TITLE_MAX = 120


def db_path() -> str:
    """Database path, read at call time so tests can override it."""
    return os.environ.get("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")


@contextmanager
def connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path())
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    try:
        yield conn
        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def init_db() -> None:
    schema = SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    with connect() as conn:
        conn.executescript(schema)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
    init_db()
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="Notes service", version="1.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)


class NoteIn(BaseModel):
    title: str
    body: str = ""
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    # Fixed-width ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, e.g. 2024-01-01T12:00:00.000000+00:00
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds")


def validate_title(title: str) -> None:
    if not (TITLE_MIN <= len(title) <= TITLE_MAX):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"title must be {TITLE_MIN} to {TITLE_MAX} characters",
        )


def validate_tag(tag: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(tag, str) or TAG_RE.fullmatch(tag) is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"invalid tag {tag!r}: must be 1 to 30 lowercase letters or digits",
        )


def tags_for_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> List[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT t.name FROM tags t "
        "JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.tag_id = t.id "
        "WHERE nt.note_id = ? ORDER BY t.name",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    return [row["name"] for row in rows]


def row_to_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "body": row["body"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "tags": tags_for_note(conn, row["id"]),
    }


def fetch_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes WHERE id = ?",
        (note_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return row_to_note(conn, row)


@app.post("/notes", status_code=201)
def create_note(note: NoteIn) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    validate_title(note.title)
    for tag in note.tags:
        validate_tag(tag)
    unique_tags = list(dict.fromkeys(note.tags))  # dedupe, keep order

    with connect() as conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (note.title, note.body, utc_now_iso()),
        )
        note_id = cur.lastrowid
        for name in unique_tags:
            conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags (name) VALUES (?)", (name,))
            tag_id = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (name,)
            ).fetchone()["id"]
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags (note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (note_id, tag_id),
            )
        created = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    return created


@app.get("/notes")
def list_notes(tag: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    with connect() as conn:
        if tag is None:
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, title, body, created_at FROM notes "
                "ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC"
            ).fetchall()
        else:
            validate_tag(tag)
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT n.id, n.title, n.body, n.created_at FROM notes n "
                "JOIN note_tags nt ON nt.note_id = n.id "
                "JOIN tags t ON t.id = nt.tag_id "
                "WHERE t.name = ? "
                "ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC",
                (tag,),
            ).fetchall()
        return [row_to_note(conn, row) for row in rows]


@app.get("/notes/{note_id}")
def get_note(note_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    with connect() as conn:
        note = fetch_note(conn, note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
    return note


@app.delete("/notes/{note_id}", status_code=204)
def delete_note(note_id: int) -> Response:
    with connect() as conn:
        exists = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if exists is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="note not found")
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM note_tags WHERE note_id = ?", (note_id,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,))
    return Response(status_code=204)
```

```python
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app import app


@pytest.fixture
def db_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    path = tmp_path / "test_notes.db"
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(path))
    return path


@pytest.fixture
def client(db_file):
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def create(client, title="A note", body="", tags=None):
    payload = {"title": title, "body": body, "tags": tags or []}
    response = client.post("/notes", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()


def test_create_returns_201_and_note(client):
    response = client.post(
        "/notes",
        json={"title": "Shopping", "body": "milk, eggs", "tags": ["home", "todo"]},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    note = response.json()
    assert isinstance(note["id"], int)
    assert note["title"] == "Shopping"
    assert note["body"] == "milk, eggs"
    assert sorted(note["tags"]) == ["home", "todo"]
    created = datetime.fromisoformat(note["created_at"])
    assert created.utcoffset() == timedelta(0)


def test_create_with_defaults(client):
    response = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "Only a title"})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    note = response.json()
    assert note["body"] == ""
    assert note["tags"] == []


def test_title_of_120_characters_is_accepted(client):
    response = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "x" * 120})
    assert response.status_code == 201


def test_get_note(client):
    created = create(client, title="Read me", body="text", tags=["work"])
    response = client.get(f"/notes/{created['id']}")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == created


def test_get_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    response = client.get("/notes/9999")
    assert response.status_code == 404


def test_list_all_newest_first(client):
    first = create(client, title="first")
    second = create(client, title="second")
    third = create(client, title="third")
    response = client.get("/notes")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    ids = [note["id"] for note in response.json()]
    assert ids == [third["id"], second["id"], first["id"]]


def test_list_by_tag(client):
    a = create(client, title="a", tags=["red"])
    b = create(client, title="b", tags=["blue"])
    c = create(client, title="c", tags=["red", "blue"])

    red = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "red"})
    assert red.status_code == 200
    assert [note["id"] for note in red.json()] == [c["id"], a["id"]]

    blue = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "blue"})
    assert [note["id"] for note in blue.json()] == [c["id"], b["id"]]

    none = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "green"})
    assert none.status_code == 200
    assert none.json() == []


def test_tags_are_stored_once(client, db_file):
    create(client, title="one", tags=["shared", "shared"])
    create(client, title="two", tags=["shared"])
    with sqlite3.connect(db_file) as conn:
        count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE name = 'shared'"
        ).fetchone()[0]
    assert count == 1


def test_delete_note(client, db_file):
    note = create(client, title="gone soon", tags=["temp"])
    response = client.delete(f"/notes/{note['id']}")
    assert response.status_code == 204
    assert response.content == b""

    assert client.get(f"/notes/{note['id']}").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "temp"}).json() == []

    with sqlite3.connect(db_file) as conn:
        links = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note_tags WHERE note_id = ?", (note["id"],)
        ).fetchone()[0]
    assert links == 0


def test_delete_missing_note_returns_404(client):
    response = client.delete("/notes/9999")
    assert response.status_code == 404


def test_empty_title_returns_422(client):
    response = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "", "body": "x", "tags": []})
    assert response.status_code == 422


def test_too_long_title_returns_422(client):
    response = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "x" * 121})
    assert response.status_code == 422


def test_missing_title_returns_422(client):
    response = client.post("/notes", json={"body": "no title"})
    assert response.status_code == 422


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_tag",
    ["Upper", "", "a" * 31, "with space", "dash-ed", "under_score", "tag\n"],
)
def test_invalid_tag_returns_422(client, bad_tag):
    response = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "t", "tags": [bad_tag]})
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert client.get("/notes").json() == []


def test_tag_of_30_characters_is_accepted(client):
    response = client.post("/notes", json={"title": "t", "tags": ["a1" * 15]})
    assert response.status_code == 201
```
